main_turf.surface: Turf (Couch grass on well-drained loam base)
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Premier country racing venue in the Central Tablelands of NSW operated by the Mudgee Race Club. Features a 1,650m oval circuit with a 360m home straight and cambered turns. Starts from the 1100m chute have a short 250m run to the home bend, favoring inside barrier draws and early speed ('E' and 'P' styles). The 1400m chute provides a long, fair back-straight run where wide barriers are easily overcome.
main_turf.post_bias: INSIDE BARRIER ADVANTAGE IN SPRINTS: Draw positions 1-5 hold a distinct edge over 1000m and 1100m due to the immediate turn entry. On 1400m, 1600m, and 2000m route distances, barrier penalties drop significantly as runners have 400m+ to settle before the first turn.

handicapping_angles.mudgee_cup_big_dance_qualifier: The Mudgee Cup ($75k+ Showcase Handicap, December) is an official qualifier for The Big Dance at Royal Randwick. Class levels spike dramatically to Provincial/Metro grade. Upgrade horses shipping in with proven metropolitan or high-tier provincial benchmark form (+3.5 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.gooree_park_stud_and_local_stables: Local trainers based at Mudgee and nearby Dubbo/Bathurst (e.g. Mack Griffith, Brett Robb, Bryan Dixon, Gayna Williams) maintain exceptional strike rates on their home turf. Grant a local track familiarity bonus (+2.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.sydney_and_provincial_shipper_advantage: Trainers shipping in from Sydney Metro (Warwick Farm, Rosehill, Randwick), Hawkesbury, Newcastle, and Scone (e.g. Bjorn Baker, Waterhouse & Bott, Kris Lees, Ciaron Maher) carry a significant class and speed figure advantage over regional rivals.
handicapping_angles.front_runner_rail_bias_in_dry_conditions: On Good 3/4 turf, the 360m home straight rewards horses that can lead ('E') or box-seat ('P') along the inside rail. When the track plays fast, swoopers ('C') often struggle to make up more than 4 lengths in the straight.
handicapping_angles.soft_heavy_track_drainage: Elevated Central Tablelands position provides good natural slope drainage. However, on Heavy ground, the track can chop up on the inside rail, shifting the lane bias wider towards lanes 3-6 late in the meeting.
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Standard distances: 1000m, 1100m, 1200m, 1400m, 1600m, 2000m. Dedicated chutes at 1100m and 1400m.
